about: Assertion-based eval for pr-description. The plugin's load-bearing artifact is scripts/density.py, which turns a PR body into a decision -- within budget or not -- so it is asserted directly rather than judged. Each case feeds a body and a diff size on stdin and checks two things: the pass/fail verdict, and for failures the exact set of metrics that tripped. Checking the metric set matters because a case that fails for the wrong reason still exits non-zero and would otherwise read as covered. 13 of the 24 cases assert pass, and they carry as much weight as the failures: a scorer that rejects every body would satisfy every failure case and be useless. Boundary cases sit on both sides of each cap, since an off-by-one in a comparison is the likeliest bug.
